name: Naramo Nuclear Plant
desc:
☢️  Secure the Noobic Stratocracy's volatile nuclear power plant where the risk of total annihilation looms over your every move. 
Keep everything running as a nuclear technician, secure the site as part of the elite SECFOR, or destroy it all as a raider!

Double XP on weekends!

[ /// September 11th | Content Update /// ] 

🔸 New Custom Servers!
🔸 New Prop Placer!
🔸 Custom commands and manager UI!

Liking and Favoriting the game helps us a lot!
( NEW CODE AT 70K LIKES )

The Naramo District lies the Noobic Stratocracy's first Nuclear Power Plant, a beacon of their accomplishments in engineering and a key asset with securing power for hundreds of thousands of citizens.  From the west, however, a detachment of West Noobia's Federal Assault Forces guided by military advisors of the Bloxian Commonwealth prepare an assault to permanently destroy the lifeblood of the Stratocracy.
